name: digitalrcs-vscode-ai-bridge
description: Local HTTP bridge that lets desktop applications call VS Code Language Model API providers.

commands.title: DigitalRCS AI Bridge: Copy Bearer Token
DigitalRCS AI Bridge: Run Smoke Test

digitalrcs.aiBridge.autoStart.description: Start the local bridge when the extension activates.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.host.description: Host interface for the local bridge. Keep the loopback default unless remote access is explicitly required.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.port.description: TCP port for the local bridge.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.sharedToken.description: Optional bearer token. When empty, a random token is generated and stored in workspace state.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.defaultModel.description: Optional VS Code language model ID used when DigitalRCS omits model or sends Auto. When empty, the bridge uses the first model returned by VS Code.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.maxRequestBytes.description: Maximum JSON request body size in bytes.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.maxOutputTokens.description: Maximum tokens requested from the language model. The model or server can apply a lower cap.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.qwenNoThinkPrefix.description: Prepend /no_think to requests sent to Qwen-family VS Code language models. This opt-in VS Code LM API-only mitigation can help provider extensions that otherwise route final text through reasoning output.

digitalrcs.aiBridge.requestsPerMinute.description: Maximum authenticated requests accepted per rolling minute.
